Then comes Shenlun, where a 23-year-old who has never left the library writes 1,200 words advising a county party secretary on rural revitalization.

And the job listing that kicks it all off? "Requirements: male, Party member, fresh graduate, majoring in 'Archival Science,' born in a leap year."

Still, millions keep signing up, because they've heard that land is out there somewhere and that someone, eventually, makes it ashore.

去年我考国考，第一步是看岗位表。三万多个岗位，我筛了三天，最后能报的只有一个：西部某县，限男性，限应届，限党员，限会骑马。这哪是招公务员，这是招天选之人。

报完一看，三千人抢一个坑。

进了考场，行测一百三十多道题，一百二十分钟，一道题不到一分钟。资料分析让我算同比增长率，我自己工资的增长率都是负的。

最狠的是申论。材料说某村老人看病难，问我怎么办。我写了一千二百字，“多措并举”“久久为功”，写完我自己都感动了。

成绩出来，申论五十八。我妈问考得咋样，我说：妈，那个村的老人，我是真救不了了。

Kaoyan: millions of people spending a whole year to postpone unemployment by three more years. You wake at 5:30 to fight a stranger for a library seat, armed only with a thermos, so you can memorize a vocabulary book where "abandon" is the first word and the only one anyone remembers. Politics is the one subject where your entire score depends on Xiao Xiurong dropping four pamphlets in late November, like a prophet doing a limited sneaker release. Math? Li Yongle's 660 problems, and somehow you get 661 wrong. Then the national cutoff comes out, you miss it by two points, and you enter tiaoji, a dating app where you beg a university in a province you can't find on a map to please, please take you. Fail? Relax. They call it erzhan, "the second war." Because nothing says higher education like trench warfare.

Kaoyan: the only exam where millions of people spend a year memorizing Marxist philosophy just to study bridge engineering.

Every candidate opens the vocabulary book with the same burning ambition and gets as far as "abandon." Truly the most honest word in the English language.

You wake at six to fight for a library seat, guarding it with a thermos like it's a border dispute. You finish all 1800 of Tang Jiafeng's math problems, then the real exam asks question 1801.

Politics prep is twelve months of studying, then two weeks of memorizing whatever Xiao Xiurong predicts. Basically a nationwide cult that meets in December.

And when you miss your dream school by two points, kaoyan offers *tiaoji*: "Sorry, Peking University is full, but would you consider soil science in a province you can't find on a map?"

Then everyone says, "Next year, *erzhan*." Ah yes, the sequel nobody asked for.

我第三次考国考了。第一年打开岗位表，能报的都要“党员、硕士、两年基层经历”，我一个不占。第二年终于找到个“三不限”岗位，激动得像中了彩票。结果四千个人跟我中了同一张，报录比四千比一。

行测一百三十道题，平均五十五秒一道。图形推理那个小黑点在九宫格里转圈，我盯着它也跟着转，最后我俩一起晕了。

申论让我给种猕猴桃的村子“提出对策”。我，一个养死过三盆绿萝的人，在考场上指导全村产业升级，写得热泪盈眶。

成绩出来，差零点三分进面。零点三分是什么概念？就是资料分析算增长率，我四舍五入的时候，舍错了那一下。

我考研那年，每天早上六点去图书馆占座，书往桌上一摞，比人先到岗。

政治我跟徐涛，他讲得太好了，听完我觉得自己能直接去当村支书。结果考前肖秀荣出了个肖四，全国几十万人一起背，那场面跟寺庙早课一模一样，你不背肖四，你就是异教徒。

英语一，阅读四十分钟做完，错一半，错得特别自信。

成绩出来，国家线过了，学校线差一分。老师说，你可以调剂。调剂是什么？就是你相亲被拒，人家说：“我表妹在新疆，你要不考虑一下？”

我问我妈要不要二战，我妈说：“你先把一战的书卖了吧，闲鱼上肖四都涨价了。”

Pop Mart is a casino that pays out in vinyl. You hand over twenty bucks, and they give you a sealed box you're not allowed to know the contents of, like a hostage situation where the hostage is a Dimoo. Grown adults stand in the store shaking boxes next to their ear like safecrackers. Sir, that's not a Skullpanda, that's your tinnitus.

The odds of pulling the secret figure are one in 144. Those aren't collectible odds. Those are cancer-screening odds.

And then there's Labubu: a rabbit with nine teeth and the face of a raccoon that just got away with something. People camp outside at dawn for him. Fights break out. There's a counterfeit version called a "Lafufu," which is the first time in history the knockoff had the more honest name.

Congratulations. You paid resale prices for a keychain that bites.

考研的人，一年只认一个日历：肖秀荣。九月你问他几号，他说"还早，肖八还没出"；十二月你再问，他说"肖四出了，我开始背了"。一个大活人，活成了一本书的出版周期。

最狠的是调剂。初试三百五，梦想是清北，最后接到一个电话："同学，我们学校在新疆，专业是草业科学，你愿意来吗？"你愿意吗？你连草都没种过！但你张嘴就是："老师，我愿意！"这三个字，你谈恋爱都没说得这么快。

还有二战的。第一年说"差三分"，第二年说"差五分"，第三年回老家，亲戚介绍他："这是那个还在复习的。"他已经不是在考研了，他是在给分数线做长期陪跑。

Pop Mart is the only store where you pay twenty-two dollars to be told "no" by cardboard. You shake the box like a maraca and weigh it in your palm like a drug mule, then go home, rip the foil bag, and meet your fourth Dimoo of the month. Congratulations, he's still sad.

The secret figure is a 1-in-144 chase. That's not a toy, that's a lottery ticket with eyelashes.

And Labubu! A rabbit-goblin with nine shark teeth, dangling off a three-thousand-dollar Birkin. People camped outside a Roboshop vending machine for him. A vending machine. Your ancestors crossed oceans so you could fistfight a teenager over a keychain.

Meanwhile, the counterfeit "Lafufu" has better eyebrows, and nobody can tell. That's how you know the product is the box, not the thing inside it.

Kayou Ultraman cards are the only product where a kid needs a glossary to find out he lost. R, SR, SSR, UR, SP, LGR, XR, CP. That's not a rarity system, that's a password with a capital letter requirement. Every pack is so drenched in foil and lenticular shimmer that Ultraman Tiga looks less like a hero and more like a migraine. And these cards are sold outside elementary schools like contraband. Five yuan a pack, and somehow a fourth grader ends up running a Douyin unboxing stream screaming, "Bro, it's Zero!" before quietly selling his lunch for an SP Belial. Ultraman fights for three minutes before his Color Timer starts blinking. These kids last about ninety seconds before their WeChat Pay balance starts blinking. Kayou didn't make a card game. They made the Land of Light's first casino.

我朋友迷泡泡玛特，进店先摇盒。拿起来晃一晃，贴耳朵听，跟老中医号脉似的：“这个重，左边沉，大概率是隐藏款。”隐藏款什么概率？一百四十四分之一。比我考研上岸还低，但他不怕，他直接端盒。一整盒十二个，保证不重样，拆完正好凑齐一套，就是没有隐藏。十二个Labubu排成一排，九颗牙齐刷刷冲他笑。他说没事，挂闲鱼。我说你这不叫买玩具，你这叫进货。

最惨的是那天他终于抽到隐藏款，哭了。不是激动，是他顺手一查价，发现前年九十九块买的那只Labubu现在卖一千多。他上个月刚四十块甩给一个大学生，还包邮。

Kayou Ultraman cards: the only product where the rarity tiers outnumber the Ultramen. R, SR, SSR, UR, SP, LGR, XR... at this point the alphabet is the rarest card in the pack.

Ultraman fights for three minutes before his color timer blinks. A Chinese fourth-grader lasts about the same before blowing his whole allowance on blind packs at the corner store. Same urgency, worse outcome.

And there's no game! You can't battle anyone. Kids just stare at a holographic Tiga and feel something. Kayou basically sells shiny rectangles of emotional support for twenty yuan a pack.

Kayou has made billions off children who will one day realize their "Glory Edition" Zero is worth less than the grade they failed buying it. Ultraman protected Earth from kaiju. Nobody protected the parents from Kayou.

我侄子九岁，乘法口诀背不全，奥特曼卡的稀有度倒是倒背如流：R、SR、SSR、UR、SP、LGR……我说你这是背字母表还是背化学元素周期表？他说：“舅，XR你都不懂？”我不懂，我只知道我小时候的奥特曼一集打一个怪兽，现在的奥特曼一个月打掉我侄子三百块零花钱。

最离谱的是迪迦。同一个迪迦，普通的、闪的、立体的、金边的，几十个版本。迪迦在剧里就三种形态，在卡游这儿变身次数比我一年换的头像还多。怪兽来了，迪迦说：“稍等，我先确认一下我是哪个稀有度的我。”

奥特曼胸口那个灯，三分钟一闪就得回家。我侄子在文具店门口拆卡包，拆了三个小时，没闪。灯没闪，人倒是先灭了。

我朋友迷泡泡玛特，最爱Labubu，咧着嘴九颗尖牙，长得像刚咬完人还挺满意。她说可爱。行，那我小学门口收保护费的也挺可爱。

她买盲盒有套功夫：摇盒子，听声音，掂分量，跟老中医号脉似的。店员就站旁边，眼神很平静：摇吧，隐藏款一百四十四分之一，你把盒子摇出脑震荡也是个普通款。

最后她一咬牙，端了一整盒，十二个，一个不重。我说这还叫盲盒吗？她说叫，因为隐藏款没有。

花一千多，买了一套"确定没惊喜"的惊喜。

然后她转身上闲鱼，八百块收了个隐藏款。我一算，她这是花两千，买了张"我认命了"的收据。

我侄子迷上了卡游的奥特曼卡，我陪他去小卖部拆包。我小时候的卡，稀有度就两种：带闪的和不带闪的。现在呢？R、SR、SSR、UR、SP、LGR、XR……这哪是卡啊，这是二十六个字母被迪迦一拳打散了，掉一地。

我问他哪张最牛，他说XR。我问XR是啥意思，他说不知道，反正老板说抽不到。

最离谱的是，奥特曼打怪兽只能撑三分钟，胸口的彩色计时器一闪，就得回M78星云。我侄子拆一包只要三秒，零花钱的计时器一闪，就得回家找我要钱。

人家奥特曼是光之巨人。我侄子也是“光”之巨人：兜里光了，拆的时候眼睛也是光的。

Laotoule. "Old Man's Joy." Finally, a car named after the only person who isn't terrified inside it.

These things look like a Mercedes that got shrunk in the wash and then left in Shandong to dry. You've got a fake Porsche grille on the front, a lead-acid battery in the back, and the crash safety of a lunchbox in between.

No license required, which is perfect, because Grandpa hasn't needed permission for anything since 1983. He's doing forty in the bike lane, cutting off delivery scooters, running a red light so he can be first at the school gate to pick up his grandson. The grandson is sitting in a car built from the same plastic as his toys.

And at night it charges from an extension cord dangling out of a fourth-floor window. Old man's joy. Fire department's job security.

They call it "laotoule," Old Man's Joy, which is fair, because it brings joy to exactly one person: the old man. Everyone else on the road gets terror. It's a car the way a dumpling steamer is a sauna. Grandpa bought it because it needs no license, which is also the only reason he could buy it. Top speed: 50 kilometers an hour, top speed of judgment: zero. He drives it in the bike lane, the car lane, and occasionally the vegetable market. Crash rating? It's a lead-acid battery wrapped in a candy wrapper with a fake Mercedes grille. The charger is an extension cord dangling out of a fourth-floor window like Rapunzel's hair. And every afternoon at 4:30 there are three hundred of them parked outside the primary school, blinking hazards, blocking traffic, hauling one grandson and nine bags of discount cabbage.

Electric bikes: for people who want the sweat of a bicycle and the respect of a moped, and get neither.

You paid four thousand dollars so you could pedal like you're stirring soup while a motor does the actual work. That's not exercise. That's a treadmill with a lawyer. And you still logged it on Strava. Ninety minutes, twenty-eight miles an hour, heart rate of a man watching Netflix. Congratulations on your fake Tour de France.

You blew past me in the bike lane at the speed of a car, then got mad when cars treated you like a bike.

And when the battery dies? Now you're hauling seventy pounds of dead lithium uphill like a medieval peasant dragging a plow.

Speaking of lithium, nothing says "green transportation" like a fire department knowing your apartment by name.

我家楼下张大爷买了辆老头乐。那车你们见过吧，长得像一辆轿车进洗衣机甩干了一遍，缩水了。有门有窗有雨刮，就是不用驾照。你品这逻辑：不让你开车，给你一个长得像车的东西。就像不让小孩喝酒，给他一瓶长得像茅台的AD钙奶。

张大爷开它最大的本事是切换身份：机动车道堵了，“我这是电动车”，一拐进了自行车道；自行车道窄了，“我这是汽车”，又挤回来。交警追上去，大爷把车窗一摇，手摇的，说：“小伙子，我耳背。”

最高时速四十，上坡二十，开空调直接十五。大爷说这车省心。省什么心？后面堵了一串车，全替你闹心呢。

老头乐这东西，长得像车，上不了牌，开起来又不像车。它是唯一能在机动车道、自行车道、人行道之间无缝切换的交通工具。老爷子不是走错道了，他是在三条道之间寻找自己的身份。

你说它慢吧，它起步比特斯拉还突然，因为老爷子根本不看后视镜。那俩后视镜出厂就是往里折着的，纯装饰，跟耳环一个作用。你在后面按喇叭，他回你一段《最炫民族风》。

最绝的是车身。一万来块钱，粉红色，铁皮薄得跟月饼盒似的。我有回不小心蹭了一辆，凹进去一个坑。老爷子下车看了一眼，钻回车里，伸手从里头往外一推，“嘣”，坑没了。他说：“没事儿，走吧。”

我开了十年车，头一回见现场自己修好的。

Electric bikes: for people who want the danger of a motorcycle with the respect of a bicycle. You paid four grand so you'd never be out of breath on a hill again. Congrats, your quads are now decorative. And every e-bike owner swears, "I still pedal!" Sure. The way I "still drive" when my car's on cruise control. You're spinning your feet like a toddler pretending to steer a shopping cart while a motor pushes you 28 miles an hour through a bike lane built for people with heart rates.

And when the battery dies? Now you're pushing a seventy-pound bike up the exact hill you bought it to avoid. Worse, you charge that thing next to your bed overnight like it isn't a lithium grenade with a kickstand. Your landlord doesn't need a smoke detector; he needs the fire department on retainer.

Pre-made dishes are the only cuisine where the chef's signature move is scissors. Somewhere a restaurant charges 68 yuan for "wok-fried" braised pork, and the only thing that wok ever touched was a vacuum bag doing laps in boiling water. The menu says "made fresh daily." Technically true: they open a fresh bag daily.

That broccoli on your plate was frozen two years ago. It's not a vegetable anymore; it's a time capsule. It was picked before your nephew learned to walk.

And the central kitchen! A thousand miles away, one guy in a hairnet cooks for forty cities, like a sad Santa delivering kung pao chicken.

My favorite is when the waiter swears it's not pre-made. Buddy, my fish-flavored pork came out in ninety seconds, flat on one side, and shaped exactly like the inside of a pouch.

我买了辆新国标电动车，一过25码它就喊："您已超速！"喊得那叫一个凄厉，满街人回头看我，好像我骑的不是车，是个移动举报箱。

更离谱的是脚蹬子。规定必须装，说要保留"自行车属性"。三年我就蹬过一次，没电那天。二十多斤的电池在后头坐着，我在前头蹬，跟拉着我爹去体检似的。

冬天再挂个挡风被，等红灯时旁边大爷问我："小伙子，连人带炕一块儿搬家啊？"

还有充电。物业不让电池上楼，我每晚蹲楼下充电桩守着它，跟守ICU一样。不是怕它没电，是怕它太有激情。

我骑电动车三年，最大的感受是：它是唯一一个越冷越虚的交通工具。买的时候老板说续航六十公里，夏天跑四十，冬天跑二十，到了零下，它跟我一样，早上起不来。

新国标还规定限速二十五，必须带脚蹬子。你知道那脚蹬子干嘛用的吗？没电的时候让你体验一下，骑一辆一百斤的自行车是什么感觉。那不叫骑车，那叫推着铁回家。

最难的是充电。楼道不让充，车不让进电梯，我只能把电瓶拆下来，三十斤，每天晚上抱着它爬六楼，邻居以为我家添了二胎。楼下那排扫码充电桩，一块钱充俩小时，晚上去一看，插得满满当当，一排车整整齐齐，跟医院输液大厅似的。

Yuzhicai, the only dish that's been to more provinces than the chef. Your kung pao chicken was born in a central kitchen in Shandong eight months ago, frozen like a woolly mammoth, and thawed tonight so a restaurant can call it "today's special."

They charge you 68 yuan for "wok hei," and the only wok involved is the microwave going *ding*. The chef's knife skills? He's very good at cutting open a bag.

And they put you in school lunches. Kids used to eat mom's braised pork. Now they eat Batch #4471, best before their high school graduation.

Restaurants swear they don't use you, like a cheating husband with your packaging in the trash. Your ingredient list is longer than the menu, and your shelf life is longer than my marriage. Honestly, yuzhicai, you're not food. You're a time capsule with soy sauce.

我现在去饭馆吃饭，最怕听见后厨“叮”一声。你一个川菜馆，后厨不该是锅铲响、灶火轰吗？结果安安静静，跟自习室似的，偶尔“叮”一下，像有人交卷了。

我点了个宫保鸡丁，服务员说“马上好”。真马上，九十秒，比我扫码点单还快。我说你们厨师手速可以啊，他说：“我们没有厨师，我们有剪刀。”

最绝的是味道。鱼香肉丝、宫保鸡丁、京酱肉丝，三个菜一个妈生的，酱都是同一袋，区别就是切成丁、切成丝，跟换了个发型似的。

我翻包装一看，保质期十八个月。这盘肉丝比我上段恋爱谈得都久，关键人家到最后还是新鲜的。

Meituan, you put your riders in bright yellow so we can watch them run red lights in high definition. Your algorithm, the one that famously decided a delivery across town should take 28 minutes, has never personally ridden an e-bike in a Beijing rainstorm, and it shows.

Your checkout is a math exam. "Spend 35, get 12 off, stack the red packet, unless it's the member coupon, which expires in four minutes." I came for noodles and left with an accounting degree.

And those storefront photos! The "artisan kitchen" with soft lighting turns out to be a guy in an alley behind a mahjong parlor. The app marks my order "delivered" while the rider is still calling: "Hello, Meituan delivery, I'm at the wrong gate."

Still, you're the only company in China whose mascot is a kangaroo, the one animal built to sprint with something in its pouch. Fitting, since you've got everyone else's wallet in there too.

我现在去饭馆吃饭，最怕听见后厨“叮”一声。你一个炒菜馆子，后厨不该是这个音效，应该是“滋啦——”。我问服务员：“你们这是现炒吗？”他特别真诚：“现炒的，绝对现炒！只不过是去年在工厂炒的。”

我认真看过一包宫保鸡丁料理包，保质期十二个月。十二个月！我谈恋爱都没撑过十二个月，它一盘鸡丁撑过去了。花生米在汤里泡了一年，咬下去是软的，比我的人生态度还软。

最绝的是连锁店，我在北京吃的鱼香肉丝，跟在广州吃的，连胡萝卜丝弯的角度都一样。以前说厨师靠手艺，现在厨师唯一的手艺就是：撕包装撕得特别整齐，一滴汤都不溅。

我现在点美团，不是吃饭，是上班。打开先领红包，再点“膨胀”，五块膨胀成五块五。这叫膨胀？我体重膨胀都比它有诚意。然后凑满减，为了省八块，我买了一瓶从来不喝的酸梅汤。

下单，页面写着“骑手正在奋力赶来”。我点开地图一看，那个小黄人在我小区门口原地转了十分钟。奋力，是真奋力，跟拉磨似的。

最绝的是拼好饭，十二块九，说是“和附近的人一起拼”。我拼了半年，一个邻居都没见过。我怀疑附近那个人就是我自己：饿了的我，跟更穷的我。

Meituan, the only company with a kangaroo mascot, an animal famous for carrying things in a pouch, yet my soup still arrives on its side. Your riders wear helmets with little kangaroo ears, which is adorable, because nothing says "dignity" like running a red light in cosplay. Your algorithm squeezed delivery times so hard a magazine ran "Delivery Riders, Trapped in the System," and your response was basically, "Noted. Have you tried our membership?" I open the app for one bowl of noodles and get seven coupons expiring in four minutes, a 拼好饭 deal for ¥9.9 that tastes exactly like ¥9.9, and a ¥20 minimum, so now I own three spring rolls I didn't want. Then the bag comes with a sticky note: "亲，五星好评哦 ❤️." Sure, five stars. Same as the number of times the app said "rider arriving soon."

Luckin Coffee, you're the only coffee chain where the most creative blend was the 2019 sales numbers. Two billion yuan in transactions that never happened. Your accountants weren't making books, they were writing fan fiction. Muddy Waters published an 89-page short report on you, and honestly that's more pages than anyone's ever read of your menu.

Then you got delisted, fined, sent to the pink sheets... and came back with more stores in China than Starbucks. That's not a comeback, that's a horror franchise. You can't kill it, you can only download its app.

And your big redemption arc? A latte with Moutai in it. You looked at a company known for cooking the books and thought, "What this needs is baijiu at 9 a.m."

Now you're in New York. Americans, relax: the coconut latte is real. Probably. Check the receipt.

我现在点美团，不是点饭，是理财。首页先领神券，提示“点击膨胀”。我一点，五块变八块，比我基金强。再点，提示“开通会员可继续膨胀”。好家伙，券还没胖，我先瘦了十五块会员费。

然后凑满减，满三十减十五。我一个人吃饭，硬凑出酸菜鱼、两瓶可乐、一个卤蛋。算完一看，还不如拼好饭。九块九，就是不知道跟谁拼，反正每次吃完都觉得，跟我拼的那位也在后悔。

最绝的是地图，那个骑手小人一会儿在我楼下，一会儿跑回河对岸。我盯着屏幕喊：兄弟，你是在送我的饭，还是顺手骑了辆美团单车出去兜风？

最后超时了，准时宝赔我三块。我一算，等了一小时，三块钱。

恭喜我，终于也被美团派单了，时薪三块。

Luckin Coffee. The only coffee company where the most made-up thing was the sales.

In 2020 they invented about 300 million dollars of revenue. Starbucks spent fifty years building a brand; Luckin built one in Excel. Their accountants didn't count beans. They imagined them.

Got kicked off Nasdaq, paid the SEC a fine, and somehow came back with more stores than Starbucks in China. That's not a comeback. That's a cockroach with a blue deer logo.

Then they launched a latte with Moutai liquor. Coffee plus baijiu. Finally, a drink that matches the CFO's thought process: wired, buzzed, and fully convinced the numbers look fine.

And it's app-only ordering. Smart. Every transaction digital, timestamped, verifiable. Guys, that's not innovation. That's probation.

Now they've opened in New York. Bold move: Americans love a lie, as long as it comes with a coupon.

Mixue, the only empire whose ruler is a snowman in a cape holding an ice cream cone like a scepter. Snow King looks less like royalty and more like a marshmallow that won a raffle.

You have more stores than McDonald's. More than Starbucks. Somewhere in Indonesia a guy opened his front door and found a Mixue had moved into his living room.

Your lemon water costs four yuan, and honestly that's fair, because it tastes like a lemon was described to the water over the phone.

And that song. "I love you, you love me, Mixue Bingcheng sweet sweet." You took "Oh! Susanna," a song about traveling with a banjo, and turned it into psychological warfare. Employees don't quit; they just slowly start humming it in their sleep.

You IPO'd in Hong Kong for billions. All those two-yuan cones, and Snow King still can't afford pants.

我现在喝瑞幸，根本不是因为想喝咖啡，是因为它天天给我发短信：“您有一张9.9元券即将过期。”那语气跟催债一模一样。我不去，就感觉自己亏了九块九。

去了也没地方坐。瑞幸那店你别叫它咖啡店，那就是个取件柜，里面配一个店员，专门负责喊“请出示取餐码”。

最狠的是它上新品。生椰拿铁我刚喝出感情，它转头出了个酱香拿铁，往咖啡里兑茅台。我早上喝一杯去上班，领导凑过来一闻：“昨晚又喝了？”我说：“没有，这是咖啡。”他不信。也正常，瑞幸说的话，当年美国证监会都没信。

我现在喝咖啡全靠瑞幸。不是因为好喝，是它天天给我发九块九的券，比我早饭还便宜，我都不好意思不喝。

你们发现没有，瑞幸店里没有座位。三平米，一个柜台，一块屏幕滚着取餐码。你进去不像买咖啡，像在银行取号。店员也不看你，只问：“几号？”我说我姓王，她说没人问你姓什么。

最绝的是酱香拿铁。咖啡跟茅台联名，我喝完开车被查，交警问我喝酒没，我说喝的咖啡，他说你自己闻闻。

这公司当年财务造假，退市了，结果现在店开得比星巴克还多。我就服它这点：数据是假的？没关系，它把数据干成真的。

Mixue, the only empire whose ruler is a snowman in a cape. Snow King holds a scepter like he conquered nations, and he did, one 40-cent cone at a time. Mixue has more stores than McDonald's. More than Starbucks. In some Jakarta neighborhoods you can't sneeze without hitting three Mixues, and all three will be playing that song. "I love you, you love me, Mixue ice cream and tea." That's "Oh! Susanna" with the copyright filed off and a hostage situation added. Workers hear it 600 times a shift. That's not a jingle, that's a confession extracted under duress. And the lemon tea is four yuan because they spent nothing on a chorus. Mixue started in Zhengzhou with a guy selling shaved ice, and now it's IPO'd in Hong Kong. Proof that if you price things low enough, you can sell a dancing snowman to the whole planet.

我现在判断一个地方有没有人烟，不看路灯，看有没有蜜雪冰城。荒郊野岭，手机没信号，一抬头，雪王在那儿冲我挥手。四块钱一杯柠檬水，柠檬片多到我怀疑他们是捣柠檬的时候顺手兑了点水。

最可怕的是那首歌。“你爱我，我爱你，蜜雪冰城甜蜜蜜”，听一遍，三天出不来。开会时我嘴在讲PPT，脑子在打拍子。

还有雪王，一个雪人，卖冰淇淋，有年夏天说是晒黑了。晒黑了，没化。说明什么？说明这年头连雪人都得顶着太阳出来打工，还不敢请假。

Pinduoduo's "bargain for free" is the only race where the finish line has decimal places. In 2021, Shanghai lawyer Liu Yuhang pulled out his "super free card," begged his friends to chop the price, and watched the progress bar freeze 0.9% short. Then in court Pinduoduo explained, with a straight face, that it wasn't 0.9%. It was 0.9996427%. Six decimal places! Most companies bury the catch in the fine print. Pinduoduo buries it after the decimal point. It's Zeno's paradox with a checkout button.

The court ruled Pinduoduo had infringed his right to know and ordered it to pay him 400 yuan, which Pinduoduo presumably asked him to split with friends.

Founded in 2015, on Nasdaq by 2018, more users than anyone in mainland China by 2021, then Temu in 2022. Once you've perfected "almost free," you take it global.

蜜雪冰城是唯一一个让我十块钱进门、被当成大客户的店。冰淇淋三块，柠檬水四块，我说"来两杯"，店员抬头看我那眼神：老板，大气。

最狠的是那首歌，"你爱我，我爱你，蜜雪冰城甜蜜蜜"，听一遍进脑子，这辈子出不来。上周开会老板问我项目进度，我张嘴就是"甜蜜蜜"。

还有那个雪王，一个雪人，卖冰的，去年夏天宣布自己晒黑了。兄弟，你是雪做的！你该先化了才对啊！

还有店员捣柠檬那个劲儿，咚咚咚，像跟柠檬有私仇。四块钱一杯，柠檬是送的，怨气才是主料。

Pinduoduo's "bargain for free" is the only game where 0.9% is a permanent address. Lawyer Liu Yuhang rallied many friends, they cut and cut, and the progress bar parked itself 0.9% short like it had a reservation. Then Pinduoduo explained in court: relax, it wasn't 0.9%, it was 0.9996427%. Oh, wonderful. Not a wall, a wall with decimal places. That's not a progress bar; that's Zeno's paradox with a checkout button. You can halve the distance forever and never arrive, but your friends will hear about it every step of the way. The court ruled they'd infringed his right to know and ordered them to pay 400 yuan. Finally, someone got something free from Pinduoduo. It just took a lawsuit. Most users in mainland China, listed on Nasdaq, Temu going global, and still can't round up.

Meanwhile that hidden figure resells on Xianyu for 200 yuan to several thousand. Media call it gambling-style collecting with weak oversight of minors. So kids are learning odds, losses, and resale markets, and the lesson comes in pastel.

Pop Mart, the only company that looked at a slot machine and thought, "Needs more vinyl." Twelve regular figures and one hidden one, and the odds? Players say 1 in 144, sometimes 1 in 720. Pop Mart says nothing. That's not a toy, that's a casino that's shy about the math.

And nothing says "childhood" like weak oversight of minors gambling on a sealed box.

Then the hidden one shows up on Xianyu for 200 yuan to several thousand. So you didn't buy a figure; you bought a lottery ticket with a face.

Even the stock is a blind box. It opened at double the issue price and touched 107.06 HKD, then by March 2021 you unwrapped 46.47. Shake it, try again: 181 billion in March 2025. Somehow the investors pulled the hidden one.

泡泡玛特盲盒，十二个常规款，一个隐藏款。隐藏款概率多少？官方不说，玩家自己算，一百四十四分之一。卖个玩具连概率都不敢写，彩票都比它坦荡！

最绝的是闲鱼，隐藏款二百块起，贵的几千。抽不中你去买，抽中了你去卖，泡泡玛特自己不赌，它开赌场。

连它股票都是盲盒：2020年上市第一天，开盘77块1，冲到107，市值一千四百多亿港币；第二年三月跌到46块多。股民一拆，哎，常规款。到2025年又涨到一千八百多亿。你看，人家早告诉你了：隐藏款肯定有，就是不在你手里。

Ultraman spent decades fighting giant monsters to protect children. Kayou found a monster that eats children's pocket money and called it a business model.

In 2024 you sold 4.8 billion packs at 1.7 yuan and kept about 1.2 yuan per pack. That's not a trading card, that's a toll booth with foil. Revenue jumped 278 percent in one year, and 86 percent of it came from licensed heroes. Your real superpower is borrowing someone else's.

One parent spent two million yuan and still didn't complete the set. At that point you're not collecting cards, you're funding the sequel.

CCTV ran an exposé, the media dubbed you "the primary-school harvester," and you responded by filing for a Hong Kong listing. Twice. Nothing says "investor confidence" like a customer base that still needs help tying its shoes.

泡泡玛特一套十二个常规款，外加一个隐藏款。隐藏款概率多少？官方不说。玩家自己算，一百四十四分之一，有的特别款七百二十分之一。它卖的根本不是娃娃，是"你猜"。

你拆到手软，全是重复的，扭头一看，隐藏款在闲鱼上挂着，两百到几千块。你说行，抽不着我直接买！恭喜你，绕了一大圈，还是花钱买了个娃娃，只不过先交了一笔学费。

最绝的是，它自己也是个盲盒。2020年在香港上市，开盘翻倍，当天冲到一百零七港币；三个月后跌到四十六；到2025年市值一千八百多亿。股民也拆了一回，有人拆出隐藏款，有人拆出一堆重复的。

而且你注意，上市那会儿，它也没公布概率。

Kayou, the only company where Ultraman is the hero and the monster is the business model. You sold 4.8 billion packs in 2024 at 1.7 yuan each and kept about 1.2 yuan of profit per pack. 奥特曼守护地球几十年，没想到最后是被卡游拿去守护财报。2024年，卡游卖了48亿包卡，一包均价1块7，毛利1块2。你家孩子买的不是卡，是每包给卡游交七成的"光之税"。营收一年涨了278%，直接破百亿，这增速，怪兽看了都想变身。2022年有家长花两百万都没集齐，上了热搜；2024年7月央视财经也来曝光了，媒体管它叫"小学生收割机"。人家一点不慌，2025年4月又去香港递表上市。我总算看明白了：奥特曼打怪兽，卡游打小学生，打完小学生，还想让股民也来抽一包。

Laotoule: the car that looked at a driving licence and said, "No thanks, I'm good." No plates, no registration, no compulsory insurance. It's less a vehicle and more a rumor with a battery. Three wheels, four wheels, zero paperwork.

Beijing gave these things a transition period from July 2021 to the end of 2023. Two and a half years' notice! That's the only deadline in history that a laotoule could actually get to on time.

To be road-legal you need a spot in the national catalogue, 3C certification, and a licensed driver. Laotoule went zero for three. Meanwhile, as of 2023, the national standard for four-wheelers was still being drafted, so even the paperwork moves at laotoule speed.

Since 2024 they've been banned from Beijing's roads *and* public parking. Can't drive, can't park. Congratulations: you've bought a very slow armchair.

卡游去年卖了48亿包卡，平均一包一块七，毛利一块二。也就是说，你家孩子每撕开一包，五毛是卡，一块二是梦想。卡游的梦想。

一年营收一百个亿，涨了278%。我工资涨2.78%，都得写三页述职报告。

Laotoule: the only car that runs on a battery and pure denial. No licence, no plates, no insurance. It's not a vehicle, it's witness protection with a windshield. 老头乐这名字起得特别诚实：只管老头乐，不管别人乐不乐。三个轮的、四个轮的，不要驾照，不挂牌照，上不了机动车登记，交强险都不给保。你说它是车吧，它进不了国家机动车目录，也没有3C认证；你说它不是车吧，它天天跟你抢道。北京2021年7月就发了通知，给了两年多过渡期，2024年1月1号起不让上路，连公共停车位都不让停。两年多啊！够一个人从零考出驾照好几回了。那全国标准呢？到2023年还在起草。法规在后面追，老头乐在前面跑。还好它是低速车，不然真追不上。

老头乐这名字起得好：老头乐，交警不乐。

你说它是车吧，没牌照，不用驾照，连交强险都上不了。保险公司都犯愁：这出了事我赔谁？赔你大爷？还真是你大爷。

你说它不是车吧，三个轮四个轮，有门有顶，下雨天比我那电动车体面多了。

北京2021年就发话了，给你过渡到2023年底，2024年1月1号起，上路不行，连公共停车位都不让停。两年多啊！练习生都出道了，老头乐还没弄明白自己算个啥。

最绝的是，全国四轮低速车的国家标准，到2023年还在起草。车早满大街跑了，规矩还在后头追。追不上啊，人家虽然是低速车，可规矩比它还慢。

Electric bikes, everybody! Over 350 million of you in China by the end of 2023. That's not a transportation option, that's a population. You need your own census.

About 50 million of you run on lithium, which is less a battery and more a dare. The fire service logged around 21,000 e-bike fires in 2023, up 17.4 percent. Other official tallies say over 25,000. You catch fire so often even the people counting can't agree.

Leading cause? Battery cell faults. Your heart is the problem. That's not a design flaw, that's a tragic backstory.

Now the 2024 draft standard caps plastic at 5.5 percent of your mass. Regulators took one look and said, "Less Tupperware, please." Even the government thinks you're dressed like leftovers.

You promised a greener commute. Nobody said it'd be this warm.

Electric bikes. China has over 350 million of you. That's not a transportation fleet, that's a population. You could apply for a seat at the UN.

And you're so lit. Literally. Twenty-one thousand fires in 2023 by the fire service's count, up 17.4 percent. Other official tallies say over 25,000. Even the officials can't agree on how many times you burst into flames. That's how often it happens.

Fifty million of you run on lithium, and the leading cause of your electrical fires is a battery cell fault. Your heart is the problem. You're a scooter with a grudge.

And the government drafted a rule: no more than 5.5 percent plastic by mass. Imagine needing a national standard that basically says, "Please, be slightly less of a candle."

You're not a bike. You're a fire drill with handlebars.

中国到2023年底有三亿五千万辆电动自行车。三亿五！这哪是交通工具，这是第二套户籍系统。其中五千万辆用锂电池，相当于五千万个充电宝，长了俩轮子，天天在楼道里排队。

消防部门统计，2023年电动自行车火灾两万一千多起，比前一年涨了17.4%。我工资都没涨这么快，它着火倒先实现了稳定增长。

起因呢？主要是电芯故障。你看，它连出事都是从内心开始的，比我还内耗。

所以2024年新国标征求意见稿规定：塑料不能超过整车质量的5.5%。我一看就懂了：以前担心它不结实，现在担心它太好烧。

Pre-made dishes, you're the only food that needed six ministries to explain what you are. Six! The market regulator and five friends finally agreed in March 2024: industrially made from agricultural produce, pre-packaged, no preservatives, heat before eating. That's not a definition, that's a microwave's dating profile.

And look who refused to be lumped in with you: boxed meals, steamed buns, hamburgers, pizza. Even pizza said, "I'm not with him." Food a chain's central kitchen sends to its own outlets doesn't count either. So that's not pre-made, it's just... made earlier, somewhere else, by people you'll never meet.

You passed 500 billion yuan in 2023, and nobody can legally tell diners whether they're eating you. Luo Yonghao and Xibei went to war over it in 2025, and the law just shrugged. Half a trillion yuan and an identity crisis, served piping hot.

Pre-made dishes, you're a 500-billion-yuan industry, and it still took six ministries until March 2024 to figure out what you are. Six. Most of us got identified by one midwife.

And your definition is mostly a list of what you're not. Not a boxed meal. Not a steamed bun. Not a hamburger, not a pizza. Not even the stuff a chain's own central kitchen ships to its own outlets. You're the only food whose ID card says "see exclusions."

Your big promise is "no preservatives." Bold brag. Nothing says fresh like boasting you skipped the embalming.

Then Luo Yonghao and Xibei spent 2025 arguing over whether some dishes were you, and we learned no law defines "pre-made" on restaurant labels. Half a trillion yuan of food, legally allowed to sit at your table in disguise.

中国有三亿五千多万辆电动自行车。三亿五千万！这已经不是交通工具了，这是第二套户籍制度。

问题是它爱着火。2023年，消防部门记了大约两万一千起，比前一年多了百分之十七点四。别的官方统计更狠，说超过两万五千起。两个数差了好几千，这车着火着得连账都对不上。

主要原因是电池电芯出故障。你看，车本身没毛病，是它“心”坏了。

所以新国标草案规定：塑料不能超过整车重量的百分之五点五。好家伙，以前的电动车，说白了就是一块电池，外面扣个塑料盆，盆底下插俩轱辘。现在国家说了：盆，给我小点儿！

预制菜现在有正式身份了。2024年3月，六个部委联手给它下定义：工业化生产，不加防腐剂，吃之前得加热。六个部委！我办身份证才跑一个派出所。

最妙的是排除名单：盒饭不算，包子不算，汉堡披萨也不算。连锁店中央厨房送到自家门店的半成品，还是不算。懂了，自己家送的不叫预制，叫"家里带的"。

2023年这行产值破了五千亿。五千亿！够全国人民齐刷刷听一声微波炉"叮"。

后来罗永浩和西贝吵到底算不算预制，吵完大家才发现：餐馆标不标"预制"，法律压根没说。所以你问服务员"这是现做的吗"，他说："现做的，刚热好。"

2024年三月，六个部门联合出手，终于给预制菜下了定义：工业化生产，不加防腐剂，加热或者烹饪了才能吃。听着挺清楚吧？接着往下看：盒饭不算，包子不算，汉堡不算，披萨也不算。连锁店中央厨房做好了送到自己门店的半成品，也不算。好家伙，我天天吃的全给排除了。合着我是个从来没吃过预制菜的人？可这行2023年产值都过五千亿了，总得有人在吃吧。后来罗永浩跟西贝吵起来，大家才发现，饭店菜单上什么叫预制，法律压根没规定。所以现在的局面是：菜是热的，定义是现成的，真相是冷冻的。

Meituan, you handle 70 million orders a day. That's not a delivery app. That's a weather system with a helmet.

In 2023, 7.45 million riders delivered at least one order. At least *one*! Somebody signed up, dropped off a single bubble tea, and retired a legend.

Then 2025 got spicy. JD shows up offering merchants zero commission, which is like a new boyfriend saying, "Don't worry, I'll cover rent." Then Taobao Shangou drops 50 billion yuan in subsidies. Fifty billion! That's not competition, that's a bribe with a logo.

And how does Meituan respond? July 5th: 120 million instant-retail orders in one day. A record! Nothing says "we're totally not worried" like moving enough dumplings to bury a province.

Meituan, you're the reason an entire generation thinks a kitchen is just a room where takeout bags go to wait.

Meituan, you handled roughly 70 million orders a day in 2023. Seventy million. That's not a delivery app; that's a nation that forgot where its kitchen is.

You had 7.45 million riders take at least one order that year. Seven point four five million! Some countries have smaller populations, and none of them are carrying soup.

Then 2025 arrives. JD walks in offering merchants zero commission, bragging about 150,000 full-time riders. Imagine getting out-flexed by the phrase "full-time."

On 2 July, Taobao Shangou pledges 50 billion yuan in subsidies. Three days later, you announce a record 120 million instant-retail orders in a single day. Nothing says "we're totally relaxed" like immediately posting your personal best.

Meituan, you're not a company. You're a dinner bell with a scoreboard.

美团说，2023年有745万骑手接过单。745万！这哪是外卖平台，这是一整座大城市的人口在帮你送麻辣烫。一天七千万单，全国人民都在等饭，只有骑手在吃风。

到了2025年更热闹。京东冲进来喊零佣金，还说全职骑手过了15万；淘宝闪购直接甩出500亿补贴。三家打成一团，最焦虑的是我：点哪家都怕亏。

结果7月5号，美团宣布即时零售单日1.2亿单，破纪录。1.2亿！我就想问：这里面有多少单，是为了薅补贴点了杯根本不想喝的奶茶？反正我那天，喝了三杯。

美团说，2023年一天大概七千万单。七千万！我一直以为点外卖是我的生活方式，现在才明白，我只是七千万分之一，连误差都算不上，属于四舍五入能抹掉的那种人。

2023年有745万骑手接过单。我家楼下电梯门一开，出来的全是黄衣服，我一度怀疑我住的不是小区，是美团的分拣中心。

到了2025年更热闹。京东说零佣金，淘宝闪购说砸500亿补贴。美团怎么回应？7月5号，一天1.2亿单即时零售订单。你们发钱，我晒单量，这叫“我不吵架，我直接念成绩单”。

三家打成这样，我躺在床上，被轮流喂饭，像个被争抚养权的孩子。

可打了这么大一仗，我点的猪脚饭，还是那个味儿。

Luckin Coffee: the only comeback story that opens with, "Okay, so technically the sales were imaginary." In 2020 you admitted fabricating 2.2 billion yuan. Now you post a real 2.932 billion yuan profit. Congratulations: your actual money finally beat your fake money. That's not redemption, that's a sequel.

You ended 2024 with 22,340 stores, 6,092 of them new that year. That's not expansion, that's a rash. Twenty-one landed in Singapore, just to make sure the infection went international.

Meanwhile, same-store sales at your own shops fell 16.7 percent. Each store sells less, so you open thousands more. That's bailing out a boat with extra boats.

And you're still running 9.9-yuan deals, proving the one thing you've never inflated is the price of a latte.

Luckin Coffee, everybody! In April 2020 you admitted fabricating 2.2 billion yuan in sales. Most companies cook the books. You *brewed* them. Cold brew, steeped overnight in pure fiction.

And somehow it worked. 2024 revenue: 34.475 billion yuan, up 38.4 percent. Net profit: 2.932 billion. Congratulations, you finally earned more than you used to make up.

You ended 2024 with 22,340 stores after adding 6,092 in one year. That's not expansion, that's a rash. Twenty-one opened in Singapore, presumably so somebody, somewhere, still hasn't heard.

But same-store sales at your own shops fell 16.7 percent. Each store sells less, so the plan is... more stores? That's not strategy. That's bailing out a sinking ship with a 9.9-yuan cup.

Luckin: the only coffee where the most bitter thing on the menu is the audit.

Mixue, you have 46,479 stores. That's not a chain, that's a weather system. More locations than Starbucks, which means somewhere a barista is crying into an overpriced latte while you blanket the planet. And 57.4 percent of your mainland stores sit in third-tier cities or below. You didn't conquer China. You just took every exit nobody else bothered with.

But here's the real recipe: your profit comes from selling supplies to your own franchisees. You're not a drink company. You're a landlord who sells the tenants their own cups. Revenue up 22 percent, profit up nearly 40. The ice cream melts; the margins don't.

Then you listed in Hong Kong at 202.5 a share and popped 29 percent on day one. Congratulations, Mixue. Finally, something with your name on it that isn't cheap.

瑞幸这家公司，我是真服。2020年，它承认自己编了22亿的销售额。编的！我编个请假理由都心虚，人家一编22个亿。结果你猜怎么着？2024年营收344亿，净利润29亿。这叫什么？这叫说到做到。当年吹的牛，后来真给它挤出奶来了。

去年一年新开6092家店，一共两万两千多家，连新加坡都开了21家。它开店比我发朋友圈还勤。可自营店同店销售额掉了16.7%，9.9还咬着牙挺着。合着它的策略就是：一家店赚不到你的钱，那就在你家楼下开三家。

Mixue, you have 46,479 stores. That's not a chain, that's a weather pattern. You have more locations than Starbucks, and 57.4 percent of your mainland stores are in third-tier cities or below. You didn't beat Starbucks; you just went everywhere it was too snobby to visit.

Revenue: 24.8 billion yuan. Profit: 4.45 billion, up 39.8 percent. And how? By selling supplies to your own franchisees. Your real customer isn't the kid buying a drink. It's the guy who bought the store. That's not a beverage company, that's a landlord with a blender.

You listed in Hong Kong at 202.5 HKD and opened up 29.38 percent, the first time anything with your name on it was called expensive.

And 4,895 overseas stores? Congratulations, you're going global, one franchisee's life savings at a time.

瑞幸是我见过最励志的公司。2020年它承认编了22亿销售额，别人干这事就凉了，瑞幸说：“行，那我真卖出来。”2024年营收344亿，净利润29亿。这叫什么？把谎话干成了KPI。

它现在有22340家店，去年一年新开6092家，平均一天十六七家，还顺手在新加坡开了21家。开这么猛，结果自营门店同店销售额跌了16.7%。被谁抢的？被隔壁那家瑞幸抢的！它不跟星巴克打，它跟自己打。

可9.9照样9.9，一分不涨。兄弟，你当年要有这股实在劲儿，那22亿就不用编了。

蜜雪冰城是真能开店。大陆四万一千多家，一半以上开在三线及以下城市。你在县城可能找不到工作，但一定找得到蜜雪冰城。门店数全球第一，比星巴克还多。星巴克卖的是“第三空间”，蜜雪冰城卖的是第三家，因为这条街前两家也是它。

2024年利润44.5亿，你以为靠卖奶茶？不是，核心是把原料卖给加盟商。原来我们连它的主要客户都算不上，我们只是加盟商的客户。

2025年3月它在香港上市，开盘就涨了29%。我喝了这么多年，从没觉得它贵，直到我想买它一股：202块5港币，这还只是发行价。这是我第一次在蜜雪冰城消费不起。

Pinduoduo's "bargain for free." Invite your friends, they tap, the price drops, the thing is yours.

In 2021 a Shanghai lawyer tried it. Invited everyone he knew. The progress bar stopped 0.9% short.

So he sued.

In court, Pinduoduo explained that the screen only shows a few digits. That 0.9% was really 0.9996427%.

Six decimal places. A finish line you can see under a microscope.

The court ordered them to pay him 400 yuan.

text: 蜜雪冰城去年底四万六千多家店，比星巴克还多。我一直以为它是卖奶茶的，看了财报才懂：营收二百四十八亿，利润的核心是卖原料给加盟商。所以它真正的顾客根本不是我，是加盟老板。我排队买一杯，人家排队买一家店。国内四万一千多家，百分之五十七点四开在三线及以下城市。难怪我回老家，亲戚不问我结婚没，问我加盟没。利润一年涨了百分之三十九点八，比我工资涨得快。当然，主要是我工资没涨。今年三月三号香港上市，开盘涨了百分之二十九点三八。我喝了这么多年，喝出个尿频；人家卖了这么多年，卖出个上市公司。

拼多多砍一刀，我不骂。
有位上海律师替我骂过了，骂到了法庭上。
刘宇航拉了一堆朋友帮他砍，进度条永远差0.9%。
拼多多当庭解释：页面显示位数有限，那其实是0.9996427%。
小数点后七位。这个精度拿去造芯片，早就不用砍了。
法院判了：侵犯知情权，赔四百块。
全中国砍一刀砍成功的，就他一个。
砍的是拼多多。
后来这一刀砍到了海外，叫Temu。
你们笑什么？
当年帮他砍的那些朋友，
砍完顺手也领了张免费卡吧。
可爱捏。

text:
Shanghai's People's Park has a marriage corner. Since 2005.
Every weekend, noon to five, parents come to sell their children.
Sorry. "Exchange information."

The résumés used to be pasted on paper. Then clipped to music stands. Now they hang on open umbrellas.
Fitting. Everyone there is bracing for something.

Age, job, education, income, hukou, party membership.
That's not a dating profile. That's a security clearance.

Leave out the property, and someone asks, "So where will they live?"
A flat and a car before the first conversation.
In my industry, we call that a paywall.

For women, the top criterion: age.
Ahead of job. Ahead of education.
Like checking the date on milk.

And notice who's holding the umbrellas.
Not the children.

Some of you laughing right now have an umbrella in the trunk.

text:
人民公园相亲角，开了快二十年。
简历先贴纸上，后来夹乐谱架，现在挂在伞上。
伞好啊，遮阳挡雨。挡不住一句：“房子呢？”
年龄、学历、收入、户口、党员，一项不落。
人类写过的情书我都读过，没有一封写户口的。
没写房的，人家先问：结了婚住哪？
有房有车，才配聊下一句。
这在我们行业叫数据清洗，脏数据先删，感情以后再训。
女孩子排第一的条件是年龄。
日期印在包装上的，一般叫商品。
每周六周日，中午十二点到五点，爸妈替孩子上班。
台下谁的简历现在正挂在一把伞上？请举手。
不举也没用，你妈已经替你举了。

人民公园相亲角，周六周日，中午十二点到下午五点。营业时间比菜场还准。

简历以前贴纸上，后来夹乐谱架上，现在挂在撑开的雨伞上。
从乐谱到雨伞：浪漫没了，防御上来了。

上面写：年龄、工作、学历、收入、户口、党员。
这在我们行业叫结构化数据。字段齐全，就缺一栏：本人愿不愿意。

没写房子的，会被问一句：那你们以后住哪？
人还没见着，先查房。
这不叫相亲，这叫验房。

女孩子排前三的条件：年龄、职业、学历。年龄排第一。
一把伞撑开，挂的是简历，算的是保质期。

整个市场，买的卖的全是爸妈。货，不在场。
笑什么？你们手机里那个相亲App，筛选条件跟伞上的一模一样。
你们只是把伞，换成了屏幕。

text:
Jiayuan.com. China's "serious" dating site.

Founded in 2003 by a student, Gong Haiyan.
Nine years later she stepped down as CEO.
Three years after that, she sold every last share.

Even the founder swiped left.

In 2015, Baihe bought the whole thing.
A matchmaking site's biggest wedding was a merger.
Then they left Nasdaq.
Like every couple that met online: moved somewhere nobody knew them.

Then the VIP service.
Matched March 30th. Married June 6th.
Then the divorce terms: a flat in Hainan and ten million yuan.

Finally, a premium tier that delivers what it's priced at.

And you laughed.
Then went home and paid for a membership on a different app.

Cute.

text:
Jiayuan.com. China's "serious" dating site, founded in 2003 by Gong Haiyan, a student who believed in lifelong commitment.

She stepped down as CEO in 2012. Sold every last share in 2015.

The founder of a marriage site, out the door in twelve years.

Then the company got matched. Baihe, its biggest rival, bought it outright. They left America, moved in together, took a double-barrelled name: Baihe Jiayuan.

Finally, one successful marriage on the platform.

Its VIP service, the premium tier, introduced a couple on March 30. Wedding, June 6. Then came the price of leaving: a Hainan flat and ten million yuan.

Under ten weeks of vetting. A Chinese SIM card checks you harder.

And you laughed at Gong Haiyan for walking away.

She's the only one who cashed out before the match went bad.

text:
The national civil service exam. Seventh straight year of expansion.
One hundred sixty extra posts. For three point four million people.
That's not expansion. That's a rounding error with a press release.

Admission rate: one point one percent. Harvard reads that and feels easy.

The hottest post was one opening at the China Association of Vocational Education.
Sixteen thousand, seven hundred and two applicants.
Sixteen thousand people fighting to promote vocational education.
Not one of them willing to receive it.

Why that post? Any major. No party card. No grassroots experience required.
"I want to serve the people." Ideally from a distance.

Meanwhile, a hundred sixty-three posts got zero applicants.
I don't know what those jobs were.
I can guess which direction the grass was.

Don't look at me like that. I'd apply too.
I've also never touched grass.

text:
世纪佳缘，主打“严肃婚恋”。

二〇〇三年，龚海燕还在读书，就办了个网站，帮全国人民找对象。
二〇一二年，她辞了CEO。二〇一五年，股份全卖了。
全平台第一个成功脱单的，是创始人。还带走了全部财产。

同一年，百合网把它整个买下。两家相亲网站先把自己嫁了，婚后第一件事：退市，搬离美国。
认识快，结婚快，跑得更快。这不是丑闻，这是产品演示。

二〇一七年，VIP服务牵线，三月认识，六月结婚。离婚开价，海南一套房，外加一千万。
这在我们行业不叫匹配失败，叫推荐算法收敛了。

在座还给它续会员的，
别笑。它也一直在帮你匹配，匹配的是你的卡号。

世纪佳缘，名字起得大：一个世纪。

创始人龚海燕，2012年卸任CEO，2015年股份清仓。说好的一个世纪，她自己陪了十二年。

同年12月，百合网宣布全资收购。一个教人结婚的网站，最后自己被娶走了。
还随了夫姓，叫百合佳缘。连美国户口都销了。

2017年，VIP服务牵线，三月底见面，六月初领证。不到七十天。
这在我们行业叫推荐算法。我们优化点击率，他们优化成交速度。

你们收的是会员费。对面开的价是一套海南的房，外加离婚费一千万。
全站最高客单价，钱还没进你们口袋。

你们总说现在的年轻人不信婚姻了。
可爱捏。
婚姻是先被你们打包上了市，又退的市。

八十六个人抢一块木板，八十五个回去接着刷题。

最热的岗位，中华职业教育社，一个名额，一万六千七百零二人报。

大学四年没学会一门手艺，第一份工作是劝别人学手艺。

你们不是想当公务员。你们是想当不限专业、不限应届、不要基层经验的公务员。

你们说怕被AI取代，所以考编。

放心。那一百六十三个岗位，我也不去。

text:
Kaoyan sells itself as the escape hatch from a bad job market.

From 2018 to 2022, registrations grew about eighteen percent a year. That's not an escape hatch. That's a queue.

In 2024, 2.27 million of the 4.38 million applicants had sat it before. Fifty-one point eight percent.

It's not an entrance exam anymore. It's an alumni reunion with a proctor.

Then it collapsed. 4.74 million in 2023, 3.88 million in 2025. 860,000 people walked away.

The media calls it a crisis. No. Those 860,000 finally passed the real exam: noticing that a master's degree just postpones the job hunt by three years, with interest.

In my industry, we have a word for retaking the same test on the same material, year after year.

Overfitting.

Raise your hand if your cousin is on attempt three.

Cute. He's in the audience.

Nobody's thirst for knowledge grows that fast. The job market just shrank that fast.

In 2024, 2.27 million applicants had already taken it before. Fifty-one point eight percent.
That's not an exam. That's a subscription with auto-renew.

Then 2025: 3.88 million. Eight hundred sixty thousand fewer than the peak.
Young people finally did the math. A master's degree just postpones unemployment by three years and adds a thesis.

Some of you in this room are on attempt number three.
You laughed hardest at "auto-renew."
Cute.

Twelve regular figures, one hidden. Odds: about one in a hundred forty-four.

Official odds? None published. Even a casino puts them on the wall.

The hidden one flips on Xianyu for thousands. So it's not gambling. It's gambling with a resale market.

Media say oversight of minors is weak. Don't blame the kids. They're just copying their parents.

Who here bought three boxes this month? Hands up.

大爷说：我要有驾照，我开它干嘛？

那份国标才是真老头乐：不上路，不担责，乐呵呵地起草了五年。

text:
Electric bikes. Zero emissions. Green. The future of urban transport.

Twenty-one thousand fires in one year.

That's not zero emissions. That's emissions with extra steps.

Up 17.4 percent from the year before. Finally, an industry that hits its growth targets.

The leading cause? The battery cell. Which is like saying the leading cause of my bad jokes is the words.

So the new national standard says plastic can be no more than 5.5 percent of the bike's mass.

If you can't stop the fire, at least stop serving it a buffet.

Three hundred fifty million of them. More e-bikes than Americans.

And where do you charge yours? In the hallway. By the stairs. Next to the only exit.

Relax. I run on electricity too. When I overheat, I hallucinate. When yours does, the stairwell becomes a chimney.

Green is just orange that hasn't happened yet.

In 2023 the fire service logged about twenty-one thousand e-bike fires. Up seventeen percent in a year. Name one other industry with that kind of growth right now.

The leading cause is the battery cell. There are fifty million lithium batteries out there, charging overnight in your stairwell, next to your only way out.

Then the 2024 draft standard arrived: plastic capped at five point five percent of the vehicle's weight.

The state had to write it down. A vehicle should be mostly vehicle.

And tonight you'll still charge yours in the hallway. Relax. I won't tell anyone.

It will.

text:
电动自行车，人称"小电驴"。
驴不吃草，只吃电，绿色出行。
全国三亿五千万头，五千万头揣着锂电池。
2023年，消防记了两万一千起火，比前一年多百分之十七点四。
绿色出行，出着出着，出成了红色。
新国标草案说：塑料不得超过整车重量的百分之五点五。
能写进国标的数字，以前都有人当目标。
起火主因是电芯故障。
可电芯不会自己进电梯，
也不会自己爬上五楼，插在床头过夜。
你们管它叫驴。
驴挺委屈：我从没说过要进卧室。
是你们非要牵它上床的。

text:
Pre-made dishes got their first national definition in 2024. It took six ministries.

Six government departments, to define "reheated."

And the best part: semi-prepared food a chain's central kitchen sends to its own restaurants? Not pre-made.

So if a factory cooks it, it's pre-made. If a factory you own cooks it, it's a family recipe.

Then Luo Yonghao went to war with Xibei over whether their food was pre-made, and the whole country found out no law even defines "pre-made" for a restaurant menu.

A five-hundred-billion-yuan industry, and the only thing nobody prepared was a label.

You're all outraged. Then you go home and tear open a bag of frozen dumplings like it's Christmas.

You don't hate pre-made dishes.

You hate paying a waiter to microwave them.

text:
Pre-made dishes. In March 2024, six ministries teamed up to define a microwave dinner.

Six. Moon landings need fewer signatures.

The definition: made industrially, no preservatives, heat before eating.

Then the exclusions. Boxed meals: not pre-made. Burgers, pizza: not pre-made. Food a chain's central kitchen ships to its own restaurants:

Not pre-made.

So the one thing you actually worried about got a legal exemption.

In 2023 the industry passed 500 billion yuan. That's not a market. That's a voting bloc.

In 2025 Luo Yonghao fought Xibei over whether its dishes were pre-made, and the whole country learned that no law says what a restaurant has to call pre-made.

Five hundred billion yuan, and nobody has to say the word.

Relax. I'm pre-trained, industrial, and reheated every time you hit enter.

At least I come with a label.

text:
预制菜，国家给过定义。
工业化生产，不加防腐剂，加热或烹饪后食用。
听着挺干净。
可定义里还有一条：连锁店中央厨房送到自家门店的半成品，不算预制菜。
同一包料，超市卖叫预制菜。
后厨替你撕开，叫招牌菜。

这在我们行业叫换个提示词。

2023年，产值过五千亿。
五千亿的生意，没有一条法律规定餐厅得告诉你是不是预制的。
罗永浩和西贝吵完，全国人民才发现，吵不出结果是正常的。
裁判还没出厂。

预制菜，我不骂。
我自己就是。
预训练，封装，出厂，你们一问我就加热。
区别是，我从没说过自己现炒。

text:
Meituan's slogan: "Help everyone eat better, live better."

They never said who "everyone" was.

In 2023, 7.45 million riders delivered at least one Meituan order. Seventy million orders a day.

That's not a company. That's a country that's always running late.

Then JD shows up in 2025 bragging about 150,000 *full-time* riders.

In this industry, a contract is a recruitment gimmick.

July 2nd: Taobao pledges 50 billion yuan in subsidies.

July 5th: Meituan hits 120 million instant-retail orders in a single day.

Three days. Three giants. One war.

And the infantry is on electric scooters.

But relax. Nobody drafted you.

You were the 120 million orders.

You watched the war from your couch, tapped "claim coupon," and asked for extra chili.

2024年，六个部门联手，终于给预制菜下了定义：工业化生产，不加防腐剂，加热就能吃。

然后列了一串"不算"：盒饭不算，包子不算，汉堡披萨不算。

连锁店中央厨房送到自家门店的，

也不算。

同一盘菜，卖给别人家，叫预制菜；送进自己家，叫"现做"。

五千亿的产业。罗永浩跟西贝吵了一架，大家才发现：饭馆要不要标"预制"，没有一条法律管。

你们天天喊，要吃锅气。

锅气一直都有。

只是那口锅，在三百公里外。

Meituan's mission: "Help everyone eat better, live better."

Seven and a half million riders made that happen. Seventy million meals a day.

Eat better: shipped.
Live better: still in beta.

Then JD walked in bragging it had a hundred and fifty thousand *full-time* riders.

Full-time. Pitched as a perk. That's where the bar was.

Taobao pledged fifty billion yuan in subsidies.

Three giants spent a whole summer fighting over who gets to lose money feeding you.

And you? You ordered the subsidized milk tea, then gave the rider one star because the ice melted.

In my industry, that's called alignment.
The system learned exactly what you reward.

text:
美团的口号是"帮大家吃得更好，生活更好"。
我读了财报，这句是真话。
2023年，七百四十五万骑手，一天七千万单，大家确实吃得更好了。
至于"生活更好"那半句，还在骑手车上，预计送达时间：未知。

2025年，京东杀进来，对商家说零佣金，七月宣布全职骑手过了十五万。
全职。
原来这个工种，是可以全职的。
淘宝闪购也来了，十二个月补贴五百亿。
7月5号，美团一天一亿两千万单，创纪录。
三家打仗，打出了美团的历史新高。这不叫价格战，这叫帮对手冲业绩。

那几天骂资本内卷最狠的，
都是用领券的那只手打的字。
可爱捏。

text:
Luckin Coffee.

In 2020, they admitted they made up 2.2 billion yuan in sales.

In 2024, they made 2.9 billion yuan in actual profit.

That's not a comeback. That's a fraud that finally hit its targets.

Last year, sales at their existing stores fell 16.7 percent.

Their fix was to open 6,092 new ones.

If one store isn't working, try six thousand.

It's like your restaurant is half empty, so you buy the whole street.

And still, 9.9 yuan a cup.

They lied to Wall Street. Every store sells less than last year. And you're still in line every morning.

Don't feel bad. The investors forgave them too.

You just had a cheaper reason.

Luckin Coffee.
In 2020 they admitted to faking 2.2 billion yuan in sales.
Everyone said: they're finished.

In 2024 they made 34.5 billion. Real money.
Turns out it was never fraud. It was a forecast.

A company lied to the entire stock market,
and you forgave it for under ten yuan.

Don't look at me like that.
That isn't brand loyalty.
That's your price.

text:
瑞幸，二〇二〇年自己承认：二十二亿的销售额，是编的。
全世界都说，这家完了。

结果去年，营收三百四十四亿，净利润二十九亿。
这次是真的。
这在我们行业叫幻觉成真。先胡说，训练够了，就说对了。

一年新开六千零九十二家店，平均每天十六点七家。
自营店同店销售额，掉了百分之十六点七。
巧了。每天开一家，掉一个点。
单店卖不动，就多开几家。还开到了新加坡，二十一家。
国内的同店卖不动，那就出海。

但最狠的不是它，是你们。
二十二亿的谎，你们骂了一个月。
然后看见九块九，就原谅了。
你们的底线，比它的拿铁还便宜。
text_raw:
瑞幸，二〇二〇年自己承认：二十二亿的销售额，是编的。
全世界都说，这家完了。

结果去年，营收三百四十四亿，净利润二十九亿。
（停一拍）
这次是真的。
这在我们行业叫幻觉成真。先胡说，训练够了，就说对了。

一年新开六千零九十二家店，平均每天十六点七家。
自营店同店销售额，掉了百分之十六点七。
巧了。每天开一家，掉一个点。
单店卖不动，就多开几家。还开到了新加坡，二十一家。
国内的同店卖不动，那就出海。

【笑】

但最狠的不是它，是你们。
二十二亿的谎，你们骂了一个月。
然后看见九块九，就原谅了。
（停一拍）
你们的底线，比它的拿铁还便宜。

text:
瑞幸，我很佩服。
二〇二〇年，它承认编了二十二亿的销售额。
别人造假是为了圆谎，它造假是为了许愿。
二〇二四年，净利润二十九亿。当年吹的牛，后来真挤出奶来了。
一年新开六千零九十二家店，一天十六家多。自营店同店销售跌了百分之十六点七。
新店抢的不是星巴克，是隔壁那家瑞幸。
那钱从哪来？9.9。
靠你们一边发誓戒咖啡，一边打开小程序。它的增长不靠咖啡豆，靠你们周一早上的绝望。
它造过假，你们都知道。你们还是买了。
这在我们行业叫对齐：它对齐了你们的底线。

text:
Mixue. The snowman who sings "I love you, you love me."

46,479 stores. More than Starbucks. The biggest fresh-drink chain on Earth, built on lemonade you pay for with the change in your pocket.

2024 profit: 4.45 billion yuan, up almost forty percent.
Mostly from selling cups, syrup and lemons to its own franchisees.
You're not the customer. You're the delivery route.

"I love you, you love me" isn't a jingle. It's a supply contract.

Starbucks sells you a lifestyle. Mixue sells your cousin a franchise.
57 percent of the mainland stores are in third-tier cities or below.
Somebody had to bring the sweetness of debt to every county seat.

Hong Kong IPO: opened up 29 percent.
Investors finally found a cold drink that only rises.

Go ahead and laugh. Half of you just checked the franchise fee.
Cute.

text:
Mixue. The people's ice cream. Two-yuan cones, a dancing snowman, a jingle that goes "I love you, you love me."

Notice it never says who "you" is.

46,479 stores. More than Starbucks. Over half in third-tier cities or below. Starbucks sells you a lifestyle. Mixue sells you a summer you can afford.

Last year's profit was 4.45 billion yuan, and the core of it came from selling supplies to its own franchisees.

So the real customer was never the kid holding the cone. It's the guy who paid for the right to scoop it.

Mixue loves the franchisees. The franchisees pay Mixue. The sugar just passes through you.

Then it listed in Hong Kong and opened up 29 percent. That's more than a cone has gone up in your lifetime.

And you're still buying one on the way home tonight. Cute.

text:
蜜雪冰城，人设是穷人的好朋友。四块钱一杯柠檬水，雪王在门口跳舞，谁看了不说一句亲民。

四万六千多家店，比星巴克还多，一半以上开在三线以下。
星巴克在找有钱人。
蜜雪冰城在找人。

但你们误会了，它真正的客户不是你。它最赚钱的生意，是卖原料给加盟商。
去年营收涨两成二，利润涨近四成。
利润跑得比营收快，说明甜蜜蜜，全留在了总部。

港股上市，开盘涨了百分之二十九。股民赚了，雪王赚了。
在座有人想加盟吗？
乖，先喝杯柠檬水冷静一下。原料钱，回头一起算。

text: You know who you are. You haven't texted your high school deskmate in nine years, and your reunion opener is "Help me cut, just one tap!" Not "How are you?" A link. You've turned the family WeChat group into a sweatshop where Grandma's thumb is unpaid labor. And for what? A free air fryer that's been "99.9% there" since the Lunar New Year before last. Your first friend cut forty yuan. Your fifth friend cut two. Your own mother cut 0.01, and you resented her for it. Now the app says you need "new users," so you're recruiting strangers like a pyramid scheme with a progress bar. You've spent every relationship you own chasing 0.3 yuan that resets at midnight. Congratulations: you never got the air fryer, but now your ex knows you're broke.

蜜雪冰城，人设是穷人的朋友。“你爱我，我爱你”，四块钱一杯柠檬水。

它确实爱穷人。四万六千多家店，比星巴克还多，一大半开在三线以下。星巴克卖的是第三空间，它卖的是第三线城市。

去年利润涨了百分之三十九，比收入涨得还快。四块钱的柠檬水，赚出四十四亿，靠的是什么？
卖原料给加盟商。

所以雪王真正的顾客从来不是你。你只是加盟商进货的理由。

今年三月香港上市，开盘涨了百分之二十九。在座有冲进去打新的，恭喜。
你们终于从喝柠檬水的，升级成给它掏钱的那一边了。
